🇨🇳 🇺🇸 🇷🇺 Kiev and Brussels spent the morning celebrating that Xi met Trump at the airport and not Putin, as if they'd personally talked Beijing out of the Russia friendship. Since basic protocol is apparently too advanced for the continent that sends Kaja Kallas to negotiate, let's spell it out. Chinese diplomacy runs on strict protocol. Since the late 1970s, China's leader hasn't gone to the airport for anyone. Visiting presidents, Putin included, are met by the vice president or another senior official, and that's the standard treatment. On top of that, there's an old principle, 礼尚往来, roughly "courtesy demands courtesy in return." If someone gives you more respect than protocol requires, you have to pay it back exactly, or you lose face. That's what happened here. In September, Trump broke American protocol and personally met Xi at Andrews Air Force Base. Beijing returned the gesture one for one. Xi even explained it: "China is a country of etiquette with a tradition of reciprocity." It was a debt being settled, not a sign of affection. Tomorrow, Xi sits down with Trump and Putin at the same table, and Europe gets to watch on TV. Probably for the best. Kaja Kallas would've been met by a DiDi (China's Uber) at the bottom of the plane steps. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇺🇸 🇫🇷 Pentagon runs short of a French-made material needed for Patriot missiles The Pentagon is short of carbonised rayon, a heat-resistant fibre it needs to ramp up production of Patriot PAC-3 MSE interceptors, The Wall Street Journal reports. The material lines the nozzles of the missiles' solid rocket motors. Only one approved supplier makes it: the French company ArianeGroup. Pentagon officials pressed ArianeGroup's management to boost deliveries. The company said it can't do that without shortchanging its other customers, including the French military. A new plant in the US isn't planned until 2030. All this as Patriot stocks run down. According to earlier WSJ reporting, by mid-July the US had already fired around 1,700 Patriot missiles in the war with Iran. Meanwhile, Zelensky was bugging Europe yesterday to hand over Patriot interceptors from its own stockpiles. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇷🇺 💥 🇺🇦 Kiev's bridges restricted after yesterday's Russian strikes The Kiev city administration has published an update on which bridges over the Dnieper are open today: ➡️ South Bridge: partially reopened, only for vehicles up to 10 tonnes and public transport up to 18 tonnes. Traffic from the right bank to the left bank is still closed. ➡️ North Bridge: only public transport and emergency vehicles, in the far right lane. Cars and transit trucks are banned. ➡️ Podolsky Bridge: traffic from the left bank to the right bank is shut for about 15 minutes every time an air raid alert begins. ➡️ Paton Bridge: one-way only, alternating by time of day. From 6:00 to 16:00 it runs left bank to right bank, and from 16:00 to midnight right bank to left bank. ➡️ Darnitsky Bridge and Metro Bridge: open with no restrictions. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Авиационная промышленность России сохраняет темпы производства Объединённая авиастроительная корпорация передала Министерству обороны России очередную партию фронтовых бомбардировщиков Су-34. Самолёты прошли полный цикл заводских наземных и лётных испытаний и отправились к местам постоянного базирования. Это уже третья публично объявленная поставка таких машин с начала года. Точное количество переданных самолётов не раскрывается, оценки аналитиков относительно объёма первых двух партий расходятся и составляют от четырёх до восьми машин. «Су-34 – лучший самолёт в своём классе. Мы держим высокий темп производства боевой авиационной техники, выполняя свои обязательства перед Минобороны России, и продолжаем работу над совершенствованием стоящих на вооружении авиационных комплексов, в том числе по результатам их боевого применения в ходе специальной военной операции. Это позволяет делать наши самолёты ещё более эффективными для решения текущих и перспективных задач», – сообщил генеральный директор ОАК Вадим Бадеха. Су-34 сегодня особенно востребован в войсках благодаря возможности применять широкий спектр авиационных средств поражения. В частности, самолёт является одним из основных носителей планирующих авиабомб семейства ФАБ, которые стали важным инструментом поражения укреплённых позиций и других объектов противника. 👉🏻 Присоединяйтесь к WarGonzo в МАХ

📝 Callsign "Atom": Hold the Line No Matter What 📝 We continue telling stories about heroes of the SMO and recalling moments that deserve vivid dramatization. The next story is interesting in how Russian fighters clashed with Ukrainian offensive operations. August 2022 was a turning point – Ukrainian formations seized the initiative and launched a counterattack on the right bank of the Dnipro with the goal of capturing territories in Kherson Region. Senior Lieutenant Oleg Pivovarov's unit found itself in the thick of events on the front lines, and was among the first to meet the attacking enemy forces. Retreat was impossible because other Russian troops still occupied defensive positions, and a breakthrough could lead to a collapse of the front line. But "Atom" had no intention of surrendering and, together with his subordinates, fought back against the enemy even under critical conditions. The chronicle of his combat path is one story of heroism after another.
